title: Repeat Repairs on the Same Vehicle System under KestrelCare
content:
**Guidance.** On a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts remainder authorization, a repeat-repair share applies to the amount payable after the deductible, counted from the plan's own approved authorizations on the same vehicle system as the repair order (the vehicle system shown on the Kestrel limited warranty decision of that repair order):

- where the plan approved a repair on that system within the last three months, the plan pays the short-interval repeat share of 50 percent of the amount;
- where it approved one within the last twelve months but none within the last three months, the plan pays the long-interval repeat share of 75 percent;
- where it approved none within the last twelve months, the plan pays the whole amount.

The approved authorizations are the claim decision entries on the plan's history whose decision is approved and whose vehicle system matches; the three-month and twelve-month periods are counted back from the day the remainder is decided. Denied decisions are not counted. The share is applied before the comparison with the per-visit limit and the coverage remaining.

| Approved decisions on the same system | Share the plan pays |
|---|---|
| at least one in the last three months | 50 percent |
| none in three months, at least one in twelve months | 75 percent |
| none in twelve months | 100 percent |

*Hypothetical:* a transmission remainder of 2000.00 after the deductible, on a plan that approved a transmission repair seven weeks earlier, is paid at 1000.00; had that approval been eight months earlier, 1500.00; had the only earlier approval been on the cooling system, 2000.00.
